title: Aiwatar, wuce dubawa, da yarda da farashi cikin kowane fakitin
course_title: Rijistar Kasuwanci & Yarda da Masu Kera Samfura: NAFDAC, SON da Safe Production

say: Aiwatar, wuce dubawa, da yarda da farashi cikin kowane fakitin.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module na biyu na Rijistar Kasuwanci da Biyayya: aikace-aikacen, ɗakin samarwa da lambobi.
Tsarin kananan sana’o’in na NAFDAC yana da matakai shida, tare da bayyana lokacin aiki na kwanaki casa’in. Yin kowane mataki da kyau yana hana fayil ɗinku tsayawa.

say: Mai duba yana duba kyawawan ayyukan masana'antu da tsafta, don haka ɗakin ku da halaye dole su kasance a shirye.

say: Bi da kowace tambaya azaman jerin ɗawainiya. Gyara shi, kiyaye hujja, kuma ba da amsa ta tashar hukuma.
Tattara satifiket ɗin ku, kuma ku rubuta bayanin ƙarewar tare da tunatarwa watanni shida kafin. Sai kawai ƙara lambar zuwa alamun ku.

say: Ana amfani da ɗakin da aka keɓe don samarwa kawai, ba dafa abinci na iyali ba. Lalacewa yana faruwa ne lokacin da abubuwa masu datti da tsabta suka ketare, don haka kayan suna tafiya ɗaya hanya.

Misali, Grace a Jos tana canza daki mai tsawon mita 3 zuwa 4 don chin-chin. Kofar bayanta ta fuskanci toilet din compound din, dan haka ta rufe. Danyen kayan suna zaune a kan shiryayye kusa da ƙofar gida.

say: Sai kwandon sanyaya, da teburin shiryawa a kusurwa mai nisa. Sharar gida ta fita ta hanyar da ba ta wuce teburin shiryawa ba.
Ta ƙara wurin wankin hannu da sabulu, kwandon feda mai murfi, da tarkace mai nisan cm 15 daga ƙasa.

say: Shiga cikin ɗakin ku kamar ku ne inspector. Shin yana da tsabta kuma an duba shi? Akwai ruwa da sabulu don wanke hannu? Shin ma'aikata ne a cikin atamfa da murfin gashi, tare da takaddun shaida a fayil?

Shin kayan daga bene kuma an yi musu lakabi? Shin tsarin tsarin ku, bayanan batch, log ɗin tsaftacewa da takardar shaidar fumigation a shirye suke a cikin fayil ɗin nuni ɗaya? Kuma akwai samfur daga tsari na al'ada don samfurori?

panel.heading: Abin da inspector ke kallo

Ruwa da sabulu don wanke hannu
Aprons, murfin gashi, takaddun likita
Kayayyakin da ke ƙasa, masu lakabi, rasit
Formula, bayanan batch, log ɗin tsaftacewa
Samfura daga tsari na al'ada don samfurori

say: Ajiye silinda gas a waje ko a cikin tabo mai iska, nesa da wurin soya, tare da mai sarrafa mai aiki da bututu.

say: Kada a taɓa haɗa bleach tare da sauran masu tsaftacewa, saboda wasu haɗuwa suna fitar da iskar gas mai cutarwa. Ajiye sinadarai masu tsaftacewa a kan wani keɓaɓɓen shelf, a cikin kwantenansu na asali.
Kuma babu wanda ke aiki akan samarwa yayin rashin lafiya tare da amai, gudawa ko zazzabi.

say: Grace ta lissafta farashin biyan ta: kuɗin NAFDAC daga shawarwarin biyan ta, gwaje-gwajen likitanci, fumigation, sake fasalin tambarin da kuma inganta ɗaki. Kudade na iya canzawa, don haka koyaushe tabbatar da su, kuma sami ainihin ƙididdiga.

card.title: Farashin yarda da fakiti
card.note: Kudade na iya canzawa. Quotes misalai ne.

say: Sun hada da naira 206,737.50. Maimaita fumigation da gwajin likita a cikin shekara ta biyu yana ƙara 70,000, yana yin 276,737.50.

card.title: Farashin yarda da fakiti
rows: Maimaita gwaje-gwaje a cikin shekara ta biyu
card.note: Kudade na iya canzawa. Quotes misalai ne.

say: Sama da shekaru biyu tana sayar da fakiti 7,200. An raba, wato kusan naira 38.44 a fakitin guda, an tattara har 40.

card.title: Farashin yarda da fakiti
rows: Maimaita gwaje-gwaje a cikin shekara ta biyu
card.note: Kudade na iya canzawa. Quotes misalai ne.

say: Da sauran kudinta na naira 620, kowanne fakiti yanzu ya kai 660. Naira 1,000, har yanzu tana samun riba 340.
A fakiti 50 kacal a wata, haka farashin zai kai kusan naira 231 a fakitin. Shi ya sa ka fara jera mafi kyawun masu siyar da ku.

say: Don tunawa. Tsara kimanin makonni 18 tare da ma'auni. Yi littafin dubawa a ranar samarwa. Ajiye ɗakin da aka keɓe tare da kwararar hanya ɗaya.
Ka nisanta iskar gas daga zafi kuma kar a haɗa bleach. Kuma baza farashin yarda akan raka'o'in da kuke siyarwa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Kwanaki casa'in na aiki kusan makonni 18 ne
Duba a kan ainihin ranar samarwa
Dakin da aka keɓe, kwararar hanya ɗaya
Gas a waje, kar a haɗa bleach
Yada farashin yarda akan raka'a da aka sayar

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Gina kalandar aikace-aikacen kwanan watan, zana ɗakin ku tare da kibiyoyi masu gudana kuma fara aikin share fage, kuma ku biya biyan bukatun ku kowace raka'a.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gina kalandar aikace-aikacen ku
Taswira kuma gyara ɗakin samarwa ku
Kudin biyan kuɗin ku a kowace raka'a
